name: LGP-Bench
description: LGP-Bench is a benchmark suite designed to evaluate language-grounded planning/generation capabilities of models across a range of planning and decision-making tasks. It measures models' ability to produce multi-step plans or program-like outputs that satisfy given constraints and goals. The suite focuses on structural correctness, feasibility of proposed plans, and alignment with stated objectives.
reputation: Relatively new and specialized; adoption is growing among researchers interested in planning and hierarchical generation but still limited overall.
